caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

AI-generated images often come with a secret you can't see! 

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Google DeepMind's SynthID embeds imperceptible patterns into AI images.
🔹 These 'invisible watermarks' subtly shift pixels, undetectable to the human eye.
🔹 They survive cropping, filtering, and even screenshots, proving an image's AI origin!
